SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_week, min(calendar_date) s, max(calendar_date) e, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN is_trading_day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) trading, max(is_53_week_year) w53
FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_period = 2 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,3

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, count(*) nl,
           min(d.calendar_date) mn, max(d.calendar_date) mx
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
ctrl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(c.net_sales) AS ctrl_net
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = c.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND c.store_id <> 999
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week, w.net_sales, c.ctrl_net, w.net_sales - c.ctrl_net AS gap, w.nl, w.mn, w.mx
FROM weekly w JOIN ctrl c USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_week) ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT 'dup_sales_line_id' chk, count(*) a, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) b, sum(net_amount) c FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-20' AND DATE '2026-07-05'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_receipt_line', count(*), count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)), NULL FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-20' AND DATE '2026-07-05'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_return', count(*), count(DISTINCT return_line_id), NULL FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-20' AND DATE '2026-07-05'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_lines_status_' || coalesce(o.status,'NOORDER') || '_disp_' || CASE WHEN o.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 'null' ELSE 'set' END, count(*), count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), sum(f.net_amount)

UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_dup_orders', count(*), count(DISTINCT web_order_id), NULL FROM fact_web_order
UNION ALL

WITH d AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1
)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.member_key, f.channel_code, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM d) AS ndup_keys
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no)
ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id LIMIT 24

WITH d AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, min(sale_date) sd, min(etl_loaded_at) l1, max(etl_loaded_at) l2, count(*) n FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1
)
SELECT min(sd) mn, max(sd) mx, count(*) keys, sum(n) rows_, min(l1), max(l2),
  sum(CASE WHEN sd BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' OR sd BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) in_p2_windows
FROM d
UNION ALL
SELECT min(sale_date), max(sale_date), count(*), NULL, min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at), NULL FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' OR sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28'

SELECT 'ret_dup_same_line_date' k, count(*) v FROM (SELECT sales_line_id, return_date, quantity_returned, count(*) n FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'ret_orphan_sales_line', count(*) FROM fact_return_line r LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id) WHERE f.sales_line_id IS NULL AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2026-06-28'
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales_orphan_store', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) WHERE s.store_key IS NULL AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2026-06-28'
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales_orphan_product', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_product p USING (product_key) WHERE p.product_key IS NULL AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2026-06-28'
UNION ALL SELECT 'ret_orphan_store_or_prod', count(*) FROM fact_return_line r LEFT JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key WHERE (s.store_key IS NULL OR p.product_key IS NULL) AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2026-06-28'
UNION ALL SELECT 'store999_or_ZZ_lines_in_windows', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE (s.store_id=999 OR p.category='ZZ Test') AND (f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' OR f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28')
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_order_without_lines_delivered', count(*) FROM fact_web_order o WHERE o.status IN ('delivered','collected') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id) AND o.dispatch_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-05-25'
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_status_processing_cancelled_with_lines', count(*) FROM fact_web_order o WHERE o.status IN ('processing','cancelled') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id)

SELECT ty.fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, ty.fiscal_week,
       ROUND(ty.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_this_year,
       ROUND(ly.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM weekly ty
JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week
